args:
source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ROS_HOME=/tmp/roshome ROS_LOG_DIR=/tmp/roslogs
python3 - <<'QOS'

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,json
cpp='\n#include <rcl/rcl.h>\n#include <rcl/error_handling.h>\n#include <lifecycle_msgs/srv/change_state.h>\n#include <rmw_fastrtps_shared_cpp/custom_service_info.hpp>\n#include <fastdds/dds/publisher/DataWriter.hpp>\n#include <fastdds/dds/topic/Topic.hpp>\n#include <iostream>\n#include <string>\n#include <vector>\nvoid require(rcl_ret_t rc){if(rc!=RCL_RET_OK){std::cerr<<rcl_get_error_string().str<<std::endl;std::exit(2);}}\nint main(){\n auto alloc=rcl_get_default_allocator();auto opt=rcl_get_zero_initialized_init_options();require(rcl_init_options_init(&opt,alloc));auto ctx=rcl_get_zero_initialized_context();require(rcl_init(0,nullptr,&opt,&ctx));require(rcl_init_options_fini(&opt));\n auto node=rcl_get_zero_initialized_node();auto no=rcl_node_get_default_options();require(rcl_node_init(&node,"qos_inspection","/",&ctx,&no));\n const std::vector<std::string> names={"/oomwoo_keepout_mask_server/change_state","/oomwoo_keepout_info_server/change_state","/map_server/change_state","/amcl/change_state","/controller_server/change_state","/planner_server/change_state","/bt_navigator/change_state","/valdi/relay/control","/valdi/relay/status","/unrelated/change_state"};\n for(const auto &name:names){auto service=rcl_get_zero_initialized_service();auto so=rcl_service_get_default_options();require(rcl_service_init(&service,&node,ROSIDL_GET_SRV_TYPE_SUPPORT(lifecycle_msgs,srv,ChangeState),name.c_str(),&so));auto rmw=rcl_service_get_rmw_handle(&service);if(std::string(rmw->implementation_identifier)!="rmw_fastrtps_cpp")return 3;auto info=static_cast<CustomServiceInfo*>(rmw->data);const auto &q=info->response_writer_->get_qos();const auto &t=q.reliability().max_blocking_time;std::cout<<"QOS_ROW {\\"service\\":\\""<<name<<"\\",\\"dds_reply_topic\\":\\""<<info->response_topic_->get_name()<<"\\",\\"max_blocking_ns\\":"<<(int64_t(t.seconds)*1000000000LL+t.nanosec)<<",\\"reliability_kind\\":"<<int(q.reliability().kind)<<",\\"history_kind\\":"<<int(q.history().kind)<<",\\"history_depth\\":"<<q.history().depth<<",\\"publish_mode\\":"<<int(q.publish_mode().kind)<<",\\"memory_policy\\":"<<int(q.endpoint().history_memory_policy)<<"}"<<std::endl;require(rcl_service_fini(&service,&node));}\n require(rcl_node_fini(&node));require(rcl_shutdown(&ctx));require(rcl_context_fini(&ctx));return 0;\n}\n'
Path('/tmp/qos.cpp').write_text(cpp)
includes=['-I/opt/ros/jazzy/include']+['-I'+str(p) for p in Path('/opt/ros/jazzy/include').iterdir() if p.is_dir()]
cmd=['g++','-std=c++17','-O0',*includes,'/tmp/qos.cpp','-o','/tmp/qos','-L/opt/ros/jazzy/lib','-lrcl','-lrcutils','-llifecycle_msgs__rosidl_typesupport_c','-lfastrtps','-lrmw_fastrtps_shared_cpp','-lrmw','-lrosidl_runtime_c','-lfastcdr']
r=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=70)
print('QOS_COMPILE '+json.dumps({'rc':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr}),flush=True);assert r.returncode==0
cases={}
for mode in ['before','after']:
 env=os.environ.copy();env.pop('FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE',None);env.pop('RMW_FASTRTPS_USE_QOS_FROM_XML',None)
 if mode=='after':env['FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE']='/fixture/lifecycle_response_qos.xml'
 r=subprocess.run(['/tmp/qos'],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
 print('QOS_CASE '+json.dumps({'mode':mode,'rc':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr}),flush=True);assert r.returncode==0
 rows=[json.loads(l.split(' ',1)[1]) for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('QOS_ROW ')];assert len(rows)==10;cases[mode]=rows
checks={}
for before,after in zip(cases['before'],cases['after']):
 selected=before['service'].split('/')[1] not in ('valdi','unrelated')
 expected=1_000_000_000 if selected else 100_000_000
 checks[before['service']]=before['max_blocking_ns']==100_000_000 and after['max_blocking_ns']==expected and {k:v for k,v in before.items() if k!='max_blocking_ns'}=={k:v for k,v in after.items() if k!='max_blocking_ns'}
print('OOMWOO_LIFECYCLE_QOS_SMALL '+json.dumps({'pass':all(checks.values()),'checks':checks,'cases':cases}),flush=True);assert all(checks.values())

QOS
